Umar Khalid documentary screening causes controversy at NLSIU

A screening of a documentary featuring Umar Khalid at the National Law School of India University (NLSIU) in Karnataka has led to a controversy. The Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP) has demanded the permanent cancellation of the screening. The Karnataka Congress Chief has also commented on the incident, reportedly hitting out at the ABVP. The ABVP has sought the intervention of the central government to permanently cancel the screening.
